geometry_analysis.width_description: Irregular due to the porous structure.
geometry_analysis.surface_profile: Completely disrupted. No defined bead profile exists; it is a foamy structure.
geometry_analysis.linearity: Straight (tracking path was correct, but deposition failed)

visual_anomalies.visual_description: The entire weld volume appears to be a network of interconnecting voids. The surface resembles a sponge or honeycomb. There is practically no sound metal skin.
The internal surfaces of the pores appear dark/oxidized, indicating exposure to atmosphere while molten.

surface_state.spatter_distribution: Some droplets, but overshadowed by the porosity
surface_state.discoloration: Dull grey/black due to heavy oxidation inside pores
